name: MARINOMED BIOTECH AG INH.
summary: Marinomed Biotech AG is a biopharmaceutical company focused on the development of innovative therapeutics derived from natural sources to treat immunological and viral diseases. The company's lead product is Carragelose, a broad-spectrum antiviral compound used in nasal sprays and lozenges to prevent and treat respiratory infections. Marinomed Biotech is headquartered in Korneuburg, Austria.
